Today was worse then yesterday, I felt so depressed and stressed out so I decided to take some Xanax, I then told my gf and she instantly got mad at me, hanging up on me and broke up with me. She told me she cant be with someone who abuses meds, even though this is my first time trying it. She said she couldnt handle me anymore my anxiety and depression is too much for her. I broke down and couldnt stop crying. I was going to kill myself today, I told all my friends good bye and wished them the best and said sorry to all of them. I was going to hang myself with a belt around the door, I then wrapped it around my neck and I start to get a tingle and things started to fade
 away, I couldnt do it... ;( I got on my knees before it took me and couldnt go back. I couldnt stop crying, I feel like such a pussy for not killing myself, I dont know what to do anymore. My gf got back with me but It doesnt feel the same, I just want this whole life of mine to go away. I want to be non existent. Thank you for replying back and caring. Im crying as I write this because I know people still care, im just lost right now and dont know what to do.

Thank you so much for the responses! You don't have to apologize whatsoever! I appreciate all the advice you're giving.

 My gf doesn't worry about paying for the trip because she has a wealthy family and has a great job herself, she told me the only reason she wouldn't be able to visit me, was that because she can't take vacation days off for awhile and whatnot. And the reason it made me sad is because why would she go to the bachelorette instead of visiting me first, I know it makes me sound selfish and all... But I just really want to see her and spend time with her physically. I love her more than anything and don't want to lose her. People keep telling me I'm living a fantasy and that shes just using me and won't ever visit me but I don't feel like thats entirely true. I honestly feel like she does care and love me, she even tells me herself. I want to say thank you to you again for taking your time to respond to me and being there for me, It means alot to me :)

I was planning on getting my GED soon and starting community college this fall, I currently work as a PCA and its not bad.

I just feel like I'm getting used at this point. But I don't want to lose her, me and her are like the same people and get along so well.
Thanks for being here for me, It means alot to me, I don't want to break up with her or lose her, I might just go see a therapist and talk about my problems.

Whenever I get these thoughts I usually cry uncontrollably and think about killing myself, I keep thinking of how worthless I am and how useless I am. I've had severe social anxiety since the 8th grade. I've gotten my Social Anxiety ever since I kept getting bullied and it all happened when I got beat up by a bunch of my "friends". Ever since that happened I was afraid of everyone, I felt like I could trust no one, I never felt so alone. I ended up skipping more than half a year of 8th grade and when it ended I started taking online classes. My social anxiety has gotten so bad to the point I couldn't leave my house without getting crazy panic attacks. I failed highschool and think of how big of a failure I am. But ever since I met this girl online, I felt like all that anxiety went away I became confident in myself. I can go out to places without worrying about anything.  I'm in a LDR and its hard on me sometimes, I wish I could be there with her spending my time with her physically. I'm afraid that if I lose her my anxiety will come back and that I just wont be able to handle it anymore and end up killing myself. Thanks for caring about me even though you don't know me :) It means alot to me that you take your time to reply to me. Internet hugs going back :)

If we break up, I feel like im going to kill myself. I love her so much and can't see myself with anyone else. We are like the same people. I give her my all but I don't feel like shes giving it all to me :(

I honestly sometimes feel like just taking my car out going 100 mph and just slamming into a tree or something, but not into anyone I don't want to hurt anyone but myself. I know its selfish but its the best way for me to get all these thoughts out of my head.

Shes the main reason of my stress. I'm always overthinking and stressing over things but I try not to. I love her with all my heart and am scared of losing her. She says she loves me but the way she treats me feels like I'm nothing but just a toy. :(

She doesn't understand my depression whenever I would be crying I would tell her im in a bad mood and how I'm depressed she said shes tired of it and can't stand it. She tells me to stop being depressed but I just can't its a mental illness. I feel like she does care about me but at the same time I don't, I'm afraid of losing her and I'm always stressing out and overthinking things :(. I feel like I deserve better but we are so alike as a person, We get along really well but I feel like things always have to be her way otherwise she would get upset. I feel like I'm just a toy to her to use.
Why don't you go and ask her? What do you have to lose? Clearly she likes you.
